description: This file contains unit tests for the ImmutableDittoLogger class, which is an immutable wrapper around an SLF4J Logger providing enhanced MDC handling and thread safety.

classes.name: ImmutableDittoLoggerTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing the behavior and thread safety of the ImmutableDittoLogger class.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes MDC observer before each test.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Deregisters MDC observer after each test.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests immutability of ImmutableDittoLogger class; ignored in actual test runs.

methods.name: getInstanceWithNullLogger
methods.description: Verifies that passing null to create a logger instance throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: getNameReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks if the logger's name is correctly returned.

methods.name: withSameCorrelationIdReturnsSameInstance
methods.description: Ensures that calling withCorrelationId with the same ID returns the same logger instance (immutability).

methods.name: logInfoWithCorrelationId
methods.description: Tests logging an info message with a correlation ID and verifies MDC entries.

methods.name: putNothingToMdcAndDoNotLogAsInfoIsDisabled
methods.description: Checks that no MDC entries are put and no log is emitted when info level is disabled.

methods.name: putNothingToMdcButLogInfo
methods.description: Verifies that when correlation ID is null, no MDC entries are added, but log message is still emitted.

methods.name: putCorrelationIdToMdcAndLogDebugInfoWarnAndError
methods.description: Logs messages at various levels with a correlation ID, verifying MDC entries are handled properly.

methods.name: twoThreadsTwoLoggers
methods.description: Concurrency test: simulates logging from two threads and verifies MDC correctness.

methods.name: withTwoMdcEntries
methods.description: Tests adding multiple MDC entries and verifies their presence in logs.

methods.name: removeCorrelationIdViaNullValue
methods.description: Tests removing an MDC entry by setting its value to null.

methods.name: removeMdcEntryViaKey
methods.description: Tests removing an MDC entry by key.
